description: This file contains implementation of convolution operations optimized for Apple’s MPS (Metal Performance Shaders) backend in PyTorch, including creation of convolution descriptors, forward convolutions, and backward gradient computations for input, weights, and transposed convolutions.

classes.name: MPSCachedGraph
classes.description: A utility class for caching MPS graph objects to optimize repeated convolution operations.

methods.name: fill_conv3d_desc
methods.description: Creates and populates a 3D convolution descriptor with stride, dilation, padding, data layout, and groups.

methods.name: fill_depthwise_conv_desc
methods.description: Configures a depthwise 3D convolution descriptor with stride, dilation, padding, and channel dimension index.

methods.name: fill_conv_desc
methods.description: Creates and fills a 2D convolution descriptor based on stride, dilation, padding, memory format, and groups.

methods.name: _mps_convolution
methods.description: Performs a forward 2D or 3D convolution operation optimized for MPS backend.

methods.name: mps_convolution_backward_input
methods.description: Computes the gradient of the input tensor during backpropagation for convolution.

methods.name: mps_convolution_backward_weights
methods.description: Computes the gradient of the convolution weights during backpropagation.

methods.name: mps_convolution_backward
methods.description: Calculates gradients for input, weights, and biases given upstream gradient during convolution backprop.

methods.name: mps_convolution_transpose_forward
methods.description: Performs a forward transposed convolution (deconvolution) operation.

methods.name: _mps_convolution_transpose
methods.description: Wrapper for transposed convolution, with checks for supported types.

methods.name: mps_convolution_transpose_backward_input
methods.description: Computes the gradient of the input for transposed convolution.

methods.name: mps_convolution_transpose_backward_weight
methods.description: Calculates the gradient of the weights during the backward pass of transposed convolution.

methods.name: mps_convolution_transpose_backward
methods.description: Returns gradients of input and weights for transposed convolution.
